content_data.meeting_title: Streaming Platform API Performance Optimization - Technical Review
agenda_items: Discuss migration strategy from monolithic architecture to microservices for video transcoding
Review security vulnerabilities identified in recent penetration testing
key_decisions: Agreed to implement Redis caching layer to reduce database query load by 60%
Approved migration to Kubernetes-based container orchestration for improved scalability
action_items: Marcus Chen to draft technical specification for CDN failover mechanism by +14 days
Priya Deshmukh to complete load testing scenarios for peak streaming hours by +10 days
Jamal Thompson to present cost-benefit analysis of serverless vs container deployment by +7 days
